description: This file is a Makefile used for building the glibc package within an embedded Linux build system, specifically OpenWrt. It includes build configuration, environment setup, and rules for fetching, configuring, and cleaning the glibc source.

methods.name: Host/SetToolchainInfo
methods.description: Sets package-specific information such as libc type, URL, and version into the toolchain info.mk file.

methods.name: Host/Configure
methods.description: Creates build directory, runs the glibc configure script with environment variables.

methods.name: Host/Prepare
methods.description: Prepares the build directory and creates a symbolic link to the source.

methods.name: Host/Clean
methods.description: Removes build artifacts and temporary files related to the glibc build process.
